summary: 10 TCs reviewed; 0 real defects. is_enabled() env check correct (line 40, case-insensitive). _claim_one uses with_for_update(skip_locked=True) limit 1 ordered by requested_at — atomic, FIFO, multi-worker safe (lines 51-57). Status transitions: 'pending'→'picked' on claim with picked_at + attempt++ (lines 60-62), 'picked'→'completed'|'pending'(retry)|'failed'(exhausted) on _process (lines 89-99). _MAX_ATTEMPTS=3 enforced. run_worker backoff doubles up to 300s cap on claim failures (line 124); resets to base_interval on successful claim (line 116). stop_event respected via asyncio.wait_for (lines 129-132).

notes: OBSERVATION (not defect, design choice): no liveness ping — if worker dies between claim and process, row is stuck in 'picked' status and will NOT be re-claimed (only 'pending' rows are claimed). A future enhancement would add a watchdog that resets stale 'picked' rows. Outside audit scope.
